protocol.quality_scope: Checks JSON and three numeric fields only. It does not validate explanations or general tutoring quality.
protocol.ordering: Sequential baseline phase, then sequential preloaded phase; no randomized/interleaved comparison.
protocol.exclusions: Exclude capped or invalid JSON rows from warm summary medians.

baseline_program:
import asyncio, json, os, time
from pathlib import Path
from tutor_app.local_ai import LocalAI
from tutor_app.ai import SYSTEM

OUT = Path('/tmp/stem-tutor-v260-bench/results.jsonl')
SCHEMA = {'type':'object', 'properties': {
    'acceleration':{'type':'number'}, 'work':{'type':'number'}, 'energy':{'type':'number'},
    'explanation':{'type':'string'}}, 'required':['acceleration','work','energy','explanation']}
CONTEXT = '''A car moves in a straight line, starting at4 metres per second and reaching16 metres per second in3seconds.
A constant force of12newtons moves a body5metres in the force direction. A2kilogram object moves at3metres per second.
Use acceleration=(final speed-initial speed)/time, work=force*distance, kinetic energy=mass*speed squared/2.
Forces cause acceleration; net zero force means constant velocity. Work transfers energy. Units: acceleration m/s2,
work joules and energy joules. A force perpendicular to displacement does no work. Mass differs from weight.
'''
PROMPT = 'Reference notes:\n' + CONTEXT * 4 + '''\nUsing the values above, calculate acceleration, work, and energy.
Return only JSON with those numeric fields and an explanation of the three calculations in70to90words.
'''

async def run(client, model, label, options):
    payload={'model':model.removeprefix('ollama:'),'messages':[{'role':'system','content':SYSTEM},
        {'role':'user','content':PROMPT}], 'stream':True,'think':False,'format':SCHEMA,
        'options':{'seed':417,'num_predict':220,**options},'keep_alive':'10m'}
    started=time.monotonic(); first=None; text=''; final={}
    async for event in client._events(payload,300):
        if event.get('error'): raise RuntimeError(event['error'])
        piece=(event.get('message') or {}).get('content') or ''
        if piece:
            if first is None: first=time.monotonic()-started
            text+=piece
        if event.get('done'): final=event; break
    try:
        parsed=json.loads(text)
        correct=all(parsed.get(k)==v for k,v in {'acceleration':4,'work':60,'energy':9}.items())
    except ValueError: correct=False
    row={'model':model,'label':label,'options':options,'first_seconds':first,
         'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'quality_check':correct,'text':text,
         'performance':client._performance(final,model,first)}
    with OUT.open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in row.items() if k!='text'}),flush=True)

async def main():
    for model in ('ollama:qwen3.5:9b','ollama:gemma4:26b-a4b-it-qat','ollama:qwen3.8:27b'):
        client=LocalAI(SYSTEM)
        try:
            await run(client,model,'cold-default',{})
            await run(client,model,'warm-default-1',{})
            await run(client,model,'warm-default-2',{})
            if 'gemma' in model:
                for batch in (128,256,1024):
                    await run(client,model,f'batch-{batch}-1',{'num_batch':batch})
                    await run(client,model,f'batch-{batch}-2',{'num_batch':batch})
        except Exception as exc:
            print(json.dumps({'model':model,'error':str(exc)}),flush=True)
        finally: await client.close()

asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio, json, os, time
from pathlib import Path
from tutor_app.local_ai import LocalAI
from tutor_app.ai import SYSTEM
from tutor_app.local_models import KEEP_ALIVE

OUT = Path('/tmp/stem-tutor-v260-bench/results.jsonl')
SCHEMA = {'type':'object', 'properties': {
    'acceleration':{'type':'number'}, 'work':{'type':'number'}, 'energy':{'type':'number'},
    'explanation':{'type':'string'}}, 'required':['acceleration','work','energy','explanation']}
CONTEXT = '''A car moves in a straight line, starting at4 metres per second and reaching16 metres per second in3seconds.
A constant force of12newtons moves a body5metres in the force direction. A2kilogram object moves at3metres per second.
Use acceleration=(final speed-initial speed)/time, work=force*distance, kinetic energy=mass*speed squared/2.
Forces cause acceleration; net zero force means constant velocity. Work transfers energy. Units: acceleration m/s2,
work joules and energy joules. A force perpendicular to displacement does no work. Mass differs from weight.
'''
PROMPT = 'Reference notes:\n' + CONTEXT * 4 + '''\nUsing the values above, calculate acceleration, work, and energy.
Return only JSON with those numeric fields and an explanation of the three calculations in70to90words.
'''

async def run(client, model, label, options):
    payload={'model':model.removeprefix('ollama:'),'messages':[{'role':'system','content':SYSTEM},
        {'role':'user','content':PROMPT}], 'stream':True,'think':False,'format':SCHEMA,
        'options':{'seed':417,'num_predict':220,**options},'keep_alive':KEEP_ALIVE[model]}
    started=time.monotonic(); first=None; text=''; final={}
    async for event in client._events(payload,300):
        if event.get('error'): raise RuntimeError(event['error'])
        piece=(event.get('message') or {}).get('content') or ''
        if piece:
            if first is None: first=time.monotonic()-started
            text+=piece
        if event.get('done'): final=event; break
    try:
        parsed=json.loads(text)
        correct=all(parsed.get(k)==v for k,v in {'acceleration':4,'work':60,'energy':9}.items())
    except ValueError: correct=False
    row={'model':model,'label':label,'options':options,'first_seconds':first,
         'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'quality_check':correct,'text':text,
         'performance':client._performance(final,model,first)}
    with OUT.open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in row.items() if k!='text'}),flush=True)

async def main():
    for model in ('ollama:qwen3.5:9b','ollama:gemma4:26b-a4b-it-qat','ollama:qwen3.8:27b'):
        client=LocalAI(SYSTEM)
        try:
            started=time.monotonic()
            result=await client.warm(model, timeout=180)
            print(json.dumps({'model':model,'label':'production-preload','ok':result.ok,
                              'message':result.message,'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)
            if not result.ok: continue
            await run(client,model,'preloaded-first',{})
            for trial in range(1,6):
                await run(client,model,f'production-warm-{trial}',{})
        except Exception as exc:
            print(json.dumps({'model':model,'error':str(exc)}),flush=True)
        finally: await client.close()

asyncio.run(main())
